item.title: Sound Doctrine and Spiritual Growth: Starting the Year Anchored in Truth
item.description: As we begin 2026, Christians often commit to Bible reading, prayer, and service, but one essential area is often overlooked: sound doctrine. In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains why healthy, biblical teaching is vital for spiritual growth, holiness, and discernment.
